system.flavor: Rifle-propelled gas grenade. Load into a Grenade Launcher.
system.notes:
THE BOOK, TEXT-LAYER VERIFIED 2026-08-28 (CP2020 Core, text layer only).

Core p.64 lists Gas among the ordinary grenade types: "Types include Fragmentation (7D6), Incendiary (4D6 for 3 turns), Stun (-5 to Stun), Dazzle (Blind for 4 turns), Sonic (deafened 4 turns), Gas (see FNFF Gas Table)." Core p.111: "All grenade types are available in hand or rifle-propelled versions" — so a launched gas round is core RAW, and the cyberlimb launcher explicitly stores "one grenade (you may use any standard type)" (Core p.92).

Gas is not dice damage: the round carries NO damage formula, and its effect is the gas cloud (effectTypes ["Gas"] — the module's cloud hook reads it, radius from blastRadius, duration from dotTurns, save penalty from stunSaveMod). stunSaveMod ships 0 = a plain save; the FNFF Gas Table prints per-gas effects, so set the penalty per the gas you load. Cost mirrors the base pack's thrown Gas Grenade (30eb), same basis as the Fragmentation round's pricing note.
